rows.billing_structure: Generally bundled into global obstetric package; separate reimbursement only when global care isn’t provided.
rows.extra_pay_limits: Secondary procedures pay 50%; no extra reimbursement for all-cesarean multiple births.

rows.billing_structure: Cesarean obstetric care bills globally or delivery/postpartum; overlapping same-pregnancy claims may be denied.
rows.extra_pay_limits: No duplicate pregnancy payments; extra reimbursement or epidural time over 300 minutes requires documentation.

rows.billing_structure: Cesarean is globally bundled; delivery-only codes may reduce, with extra payment for second baby.
rows.extra_pay_limits: Extra pay limited to twins or documented increased services; elective low-risk cesareans reduced.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This policy applies to routine obstetric services and includes cesarean delivery reimbursement rules. A single cesarean section is paid at 100% of the maximum allowance when billed correctly, while multiple c-section births do not receive additional reimbursement unless modifier 22 is supported by documentation. The policy does not name a DRG number, but it governs cesarean-delivery claims in the same clinical area.
Cesarean delivery is payable as part of the full global maternity package when antepartum, delivery, and postpartum care are all provided by the same TIN.

Multiple-birth delivery claims are reimbursed at 100% for the primary delivery and 50% for secondary deliveries when a multiple gestation diagnosis is on the claim and at least one delivery is vaginal. When all deliveries are cesarean sections, additional reimbursement is not typically allowed unless modifier 22 supports substantially increased time and complexity.

exemptions: modifier 22 for substantially increased time and complexity

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This professional maternity reimbursement policy does not adjudicate facility DRG payment directly. On professional claims, the global obstetric package is reimbursed once per pregnancy when billed by one provider or group under the same TIN, and cesarean delivery is included in the global package rather than paid separately.

provider_role_restrictions: assistant surgeons only for cesarean delivery

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Obstetrical Policy, Professional - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Global cesarean OB codes are reimbursed when the same group provides antepartum, delivery, and postpartum care; cesarean delivery is included in the global package.

Policy is anesthesia-specific and applies to cesarean-related obstetrical anesthesia, not DRG payment. Neuraxial labor-and-delivery anesthesia is allowed with time limits, and some states permit cesarean-delivery add-on billing.

pairing_conditions: in conjunction with labor and delivery
Cesarean delivery following neuraxial labor anesthesia
provider_role_restrictions: delivering physician only for continuous epidural analgesia

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This policy allows reimbursement for claims with modifier 22 when documentation shows substantially more extensive services than usual. For Louisiana Medicaid, modifier 22 is specifically required for unusual circumstances with the most appropriate CPT code for vaginal or cesarean delivery, and prepayment review applies before the higher payment rate is allowed.

pairing_conditions: same delivery method for all births

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Applies to multiple-birth cesarean deliveries. The rule requires modifier 22 and removes multiple-procedure reduction, but only when the cesarean is part of a multiple birth; state Medicaid overrides can change or negate this rule.

utilization_limits: Ohio: no additional payment after third delivery
state_specific_rules: Indiana: one cesarean regardless of babies

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Professional cesarean delivery policy for Medicaid claims. Cesarean delivery codes are payable only when supported by an allowed ICD-10 diagnosis; elective non-high-risk cases are reduced, not denied. Certain state modifiers and state diagnosis lists apply.

state_specific_rules: New York: U7, U8, U9 required
Texas: U1, U2, U3 required; U3 not reimbursable

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This plan allows non-global cesarean delivery-only billing only when an assistant surgeon modifier is present; cesarean delivery is otherwise generally handled within OB global billing rules.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: For CPT 59510, reimburse only once per pregnancy and only on the same claim for the same pregnancy under the same TIN; bundle overlapping 59400 or 59430 obstetric services from a single provider/group under the same TIN. Peer: Cigna requires same TIN and same-claim billing for obstetric packages, and United Health applies same-claim global obstetrical controls on 59510..

Recommendation 2: For 59510 multiple-birth exceptions, require modifier 22 and medical review only when there are multiple births and the same-delivery or combined-delivery method; otherwise keep payment at once per pregnancy. Peer: Cigna and United Health also require modifier 22 for additional cesarean reimbursement, and Cigna requires same-claim submission for multiple births..

Recommendation 3: For 59514 and 59620, deny separate assistant surgeon reimbursement unless billed on the same claim with modifier 80, 81, 82, or AS. Peer: Cigna requires modifiers 80, 81, 82, or AS for assistant surgeons, and United Health requires assistant surgeon billing for 59514 and 59620 on the same claim..

IA — For 01967, 01968, and 01969, route any same anesthesia episode over 300 minutes for prepayment review, and reimburse 01968 only for Cesarean delivery following neuraxial labor anesthesia.
